text.tspan: No grant / abort only an existing unclaimed attempt
A policy allow alone is not execution authority.
Scheme owns semantics; Go integrates cloud services; Rust enforces physical guards. Cedar is not the ledger or external effect proof.

g.text: Upstream result is not release permission
Invalid / stale / missing witness / runtime failure / deny / errors / mismatch
